questions.question: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. Allusive handwriting creates a poor impression.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Allusive handwriting creates a poor impression.
questions.solution: A) 'Allusive' के बदले 'Illegible' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'allusive' का मतलब है 'implying or indirectly suggesting something', जो कि 'handwriting' के लिए उपयुक्त नहीं है। 'Illegible' का मतलब है 'difficult or impossible to read', जो कि 'handwriting' के संदर्भ में सही है; जैसे— Allusive handwriting creates a poor impression.

questions.question: Fill in the blank using the correct collocation. We need to ________ a decision on the housing project tomorrow morning.
questions.questionHtml:
Fill in the blank using the correct collocation.

We need to ________ a decision on the housing project tomorrow morning.
questions.solution: 'make' will be used because the correct collocation is 'make a decision,' which means to decide. The correct sentence is: We need to make a decision on the housing project tomorrow morning.

questions.questionHtml:

All those whom(A)/were at the concert(B)/could not stop(C)/ praising her performance. (D)

options.html: were at the concert

questions.solution: A) 'who' will be used instead of 'whom' because 'whom' is used as Object while 'who' is used as Subject, and in Part (B) the Verb 'were' is used For the subject, 'who' will do the work, not 'whom'.
